blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 29-year-old man died after his motorcycle collided with a cargo truck along the National Highway in Barangay Jubay, Liloan town, on Tuesday morning, September 29, 2026. The victim was identified as Jequel Yparraguirre, single and a resident of Sitio Laray Pitogo in Consolacion town. Meanwhile, authorities identified the truck driver as Edilberto Pepito Jr., 45, a resident of Kapulay, Tayud, Liloan town. Based on the investigation by the Liloan Municipal Police Station, the cargo truck was traveling from Titay’s Parking Lot and was slowly entering the main road, crossing the roadway while heading southbound.
